# README TODO Updates

- At the end of every completed action, check [README.md](../../README.md) for matching TODO entries.
- If the completed work satisfies a TODO, update that item in [README.md](../../README.md) from `[ ]` to `[X]` and add a short `[DONE]` note when useful.
- Do not mark TODOs done for partial work; only update entries that are fully implemented and verified.
- Keep the TODO wording intact unless a small clarification is needed.
